dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to ask about something.

choices.text: What makes Mondstadt General Goods special?

response.speaker: Blanche
response.text: Our shop may be small, but we do have a warehouse in Liyue Harbor.

response.speaker: Blanche
response.text: We take pride in having the largest catalog of items and the fastest shipping in all of Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Blanche
response.text: Mondstadt is a city known for its wines. Taverns are where you'd want to go.

response.speaker: Blanche
response.text: Most dwellers here go to one of the taverns for a drink after a hard day's work.

response.speaker: Blanche
response.text: You can meet all sorts of people in the taverns at night.
